subject: Phased remit plan, dynamic credit cap, and EU VAT split
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@heliopay.co>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <treynolds@heliopay.co>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Initial ask — payment ladder + VAT handling for pilot

Hi Sean,

Thanks again for the demo last week — HelioPay is keen to move the pilot into a paid proof-of-concept for our EU flows. Two quick asks from procurement and tax:

- We prefer a phased remit (three instalments tied to milestones) rather than a single invoice up front.
- Because we operate across DE/FR/IE, we need clarity on VAT handling (reverse charge vs. your invoicing).
- Finally, procurement will need a temporary credit buffer while we complete supplier onboarding — ideally a capped credit line for the pilot month.

Can Redwood propose a minimal payment ladder and proposed credit cap? We can review contract redlines after that.

Best,
Elena
Procurement Lead, HelioPay

--
HelioPay Ltd.
Finance Ops | https://heliopay.co
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@heliopay.co>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <treynolds@heliopay.co>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 11:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Initial ask — payment ladder + VAT handling for pilot

Elena — thanks, and great to see the alignment on scope. Quick proposal from our side below; attaching a one-page ladder PDF for the pilot.

High-level proposal (pilot, 3-month):
- Instalment 1 (40%): invoice on PO sign / due Net30 — covers reserved capacity and onboarding.
- Instalment 2 (40%): invoice at pilot midpoint (30 days later) — due Net30.
- Instalment 3 (20%): invoice on pilot completion (final report) — due Net30; final invoice netted against usage overruns.
- Temporary credit buffer: Redwood can extend a capped short-term credit up to EUR 75,000 for the pilot month; any draw beyond that requires pre-approval.

VAT handling (recommended):
- For EU VAT-registered HelioPay entities: we will issue invoices net of VAT and indicate reverse charge where you provide a valid VAT ID and intra-EU proof.
- For non-registered entities: Redwood can invoice with VAT applied to the billing entity; we can split invoices regionally if needed (adds operational overhead).

Conditions:
- Credit buffer requires signed term sheet (attached) and a basic KYC pack (we requested a zip for easy upload).
- Redwood reserves the right to convert short-term credit to an upfront prepay if onboarding or usage indicates elevated risk.

Next steps: Marcus, can you confirm credit underwriting and any minimum guardrails? Grace / Marissa, please review whether a Net45 for instalments 2/3 is acceptable or if we keep Net30.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call with procurement tomorrow.

Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Morales <elena@heliopay.co>, Tom Reynolds <treynolds@heliopay.co>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 13:20:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Initial ask — payment ladder + VAT handling for pilot

Looping in finance details. Sean — proposal looks reasonable. A few underwriting points and optional tweaks: 

- Credit cap: EUR 75,000 is OK as an initial buffer subject to: signed term sheet, recent bank reference, and the VAT registration confirmation.
- Invoice terms: finance strongly prefers Net30 for all instalments to keep cashflow predictable. If HelioPay needs Net45, we can offer Net45 on instalment 3 only, with a 1.5% monthly fee for extended terms.
- Escrow / escrow-like arrangement: if HelioPay prefers, we can set up an escrow sweep for the first instalment (Redwood access to funds upon milestone verification). That adds setup time (~3–5 business days) and a small administrative fee.

Attachments: redwood_term_sheet_credit_cap_v1.docx (term sheet, credit conditions) — internal: please review clause 4.2 (early termination fees).

If HelioPay can provide a VAT ID and the KYC bundle, we can fast-track the cap and issue the first invoice for the 40% instalment.

Marcus
Head of Finance Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Tom Reynolds <treynolds@heliopay.co>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Elena Morales <elena@heliopay.co>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 09:45:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Initial ask — payment ladder + VAT handling for pilot

Marcus / Sean — thanks for the quick turnaround. A couple of clarifications from our side: 

- VAT: HelioPay's EU entity in Ireland will provide a VAT ID; we confirm reverse-charge preferred.
- Credit cap: EUR 75k is acceptable. Can you add a monthly reconciliation clause so we don't accidentally draw beyond the cap between invoices?
- Escrow: we'd like the escrow sweep for the upfront instalment for the sake of internal audit. Please send the DocuSign link for the term sheet and the expected admin fee so procurement can sign off.

Also attaching a KYC bundle (heliopay_kyc_vat_evidence.zip) in this thread.

On the Net terms: procurement will accept Net30 across instalments; treasury asked about a 0.5% early-pay discount for payments within 10 days — would Redwood consider a 0.5% discount on instalment invoices paid within 10 calendar days?

Tom Reynolds
VP Finance, HelioPay
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Reynolds <treynolds@heliopay.co>, Elena Morales <elena@heliopay.co>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 15:08:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Initial ask — payment ladder + VAT handling for pilot

Tom / Elena — perfect, thanks. Summary and agreed items to prepare the SOW + DocuSign: 

- Payment ladder: 40% / 40% / 20% (Net30).
- Credit cap: EUR 75,000 temporary buffer, reconciled at each invoice run; Redwood will prevent draws beyond cap and notify HelioPay treasury within 24 hours of a near-cap event.
- Escrow sweep: Redwood will include escrow option in the term sheet; admin fee: EUR 250 one-time to set up the sweep.
- VAT: HelioPay will provide VAT ID; Redwood will issue reverse-charge invoices where eligible.
- Early-pay discount: Redwood accepts 0.5% discount for payments received within 10 days (applies per-invoice).

Attachments to DocuSign: redwood_term_sheet_credit_cap_v1.docx, 2027-05-03_HelioPay_payment_ladder_v1.pdf. Marcus / Marissa: please upload both to the DocuSign envelope and send link to Elena + Tom when ready.

I'll schedule a 20-minute sign-off call tomorrow at 10:00 BST to walk procurement through the term sheet.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to getting the pilot started.

Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Lead, Redwood Inference
